title: 99% Of Exported Bananas Are One Cavendish Variety
hook: The global banana trade depends on one clone.
closing: One shared weakness can threaten the bananas stocked in stores everywhere.
question: Have you tried another variety?

segments.say: The Cavendish supplies 99% of banana exports, so the global market depends on one variety.
More than 1,000 banana varieties exist, but exports rely on one clone. Most never reach grocery stores.
Banana disease now spans three continents, and identical plants share the same vulnerability.
